messages.author: e7c1f2ab28a2e27f
messages.subject: SWAT+ Calibration using ET
parts:
Hi Tam,

How to calibrate the SWAT+ model using observed ET for each subbasin on monthly scale?

In Step:1 general setting, while selecting SWAT, the list of model outputs for extraction enables options for watout.dat,output.sub

(STEP:3)


But in the case of selecting SWAT+ model, the list of model outputs for extraction shows the following options only channel_sd_day,mon,yr.txt and channel_sdmorph_day,mon,yr.txt.


 

The monthly swat+ simulated ET are stored in “lsunit_wb_mon.txt”(TxtInOut Folder). In this case how to calibrate the model using observed ET on a subbasin scale for SWAT+ models?
